<function name="FindMaterialByValue" parent="MatSelect" type="panelfunc">
	<description>Find a <page>DImageButton</page> panel based on the input material path.</description>
	<realm>Client</realm>
	<added>2023.09.08</added>
	<args>
		<arg name="mat" type="string">The material to find within this <page>MatSelect</page>.</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="DImageButton">The found material, or nil.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
